decision: no new paid pilot justified by this bounded diagnostic
reasons: Seventeen of nineteen source-screened current-reference errors are the existing adanta mechanism.
Outside adanta only two current-reference error groups remain; the stated five-error-family advancement criterion cannot be supported.
Learned xHigh input/trace rules do not improve on the known-adanta baseline consistently, and full-data apparent hard intersections are its proxies.
Residual within-fold AUC is 0.50 for xHigh training across all seeds and approximately0.46–0.49 for historical transfer.
limitations: A retrospective bounded rule-class diagnostic, not an impossibility proof or a population performance estimate. Additional flexible models cannot create independent errors absent from current labels.
